title: Leaf outputs bounded by the infinity norm
statement: Let $T$ be a real-valued decision tree on the Boolean cube that computes $f$. The sum of the absolute values of its leaf outputs is at most the number of leaves of $T$ times the maximum of $|f(x)|$ over all inputs $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A decision tree on the Boolean cube with real-valued leaves
A real-valued function $f$ on the Boolean cube
